items.reply: The shipped nginx configuration matches 10 MB, but the changed code introduces a mismatch for deployments with lower limits. For example, with both max_image_size_kb and nginx set to 2 MB, the previous client check rejected a 3 MB image with the correct limit; the new check allows it through, and nginx’s 413 now produces an incorrect 10 MB message. This newly reachable misleading failure is not merely the pre-existing inability to discover nginx’s limit.
